newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NATAL ADVANCE TO CURRIE CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NATAL ADVANCE TO CURRIE CUP FINAL.

text.p: Defending champions Natal advanced to the 1996 Currie Cup final with a comfortable 35-20 victory (halftime 18-3) over Free State at Kings Park on Saturday.

Natal posted their 14th successive win in this season's competition and, with their mobile pack setting up an abundance of possession, they ran in five tries through James Small, Federico Mendez, Wickus van Heerden, Andre Joubert and Kevin Putt.
The cup-holders had to weather an impressive opening quarter by Free State who dominated territorially while scoring their only points of the half when flyhalf M.J. Smith kicked a penalty.

Right wing Small scored the opening try of the match in the 18th minute after Natal broke out of their own 22 on the counter-attack. Fullback Andre Joubert collected the ball on the left wing, chipped the ball into space and Small followed up to dive over in the far left-hand corner.
Natal scored their second try five minutes later when Argentine hooker Mendez powered over after his captain Gary Teichmann peeled off the back of a five-metre scrum.

Although Free State came back into the match mid-way through the second half, they could not breach a committed Natal defence until their captain and centre Helgard Muller intercepted to score under the posts with five minutes remaining.
Free State scrumhalf Werner Swanepoel ran in a second consolation try from a five-metre tap-penalty one minute before the final whistle.
Natal - Tries: James Small, Federico Mendez, Wickus van Heerden, Andre Joubert, Kevin Putt. Conversions: Andre Joubert (2). Penalties: Thierry Lacroix, Joubert.
Free State - Tries: Helgard Muller, Werner Swanepoel. Conversions: MJ Smith (2). Penalty: Smith. Drop goal: Smith.
